limitations: Single edge defect of the positive-weight repulsive four-cycle; t=1 excluded; stability endpoint excluded. scientific_integrity: Same-model mathematical proof review only; the standalone numerical verifier tests finite instances and does not certify universal statements. No independent audit has been performed.
title: One-edge detuning of the repulsive four-cycle: an eight-to-twelve Morse transition and sharp almost-global locking
